title: CSCI 264 — Honors Analysis of Algorithms
subject: Algorithms and Theory
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define and apply asymptotic notation to accurately describe the growth rate of algorithmic resource usage relative to input size.
Construct and verify a loop invariant to formally prove the correctness of iterative algorithms through initialization, maintenance, and termination.
Represent and traverse graph structures using adjacency matrices or adjacency lists to solve reachability and path-finding problems.
